name: web-dev
description: Web development on a modern React stack (React 19, Vite 8, TypeScript 6, Effect 4, TanStack Query 5, React Hook Form 7, shadcn/ui): one entry point, /web-dev:develop, that inspects the repository, picks the workflow (new project, existing project, one feature or API) and runs the skills for project setup (a landing page or a web app), feature development, API integration, UI development and deploy setup (the boilerplate's CI/CD, unit and e2e tests and Cloudflare Pages deploys); ticket, incident and pr write the contracts around the code (docs/tickets/<id>/ intent, spec and plan; docs/incidents/<id>/ report, root cause and actions; a pull or merge request described by why, changes, its ticket and the check:report checklist, opened as a draft and marked ready once CI passes).
